# Advisories pip-audit may report without failing CI. One ID per line, then the reason.
# Anything not listed here fails the audit, so a NEW advisory is always reviewed.
#
# litellm: every advisory below is about the LiteLLM proxy server (its HTTP endpoints). This app
# uses litellm only as a library inside the API process and never runs the proxy. litellm cannot
# be upgraded because every release with the fixes requires openai<3, while the OpenAI
# categorizer needs openai>=3.26. Revisit when litellm supports openai 3, or when the OpenAI
# chat path moves off litellm.
#
# opentelemetry-api: the fix (1.45.1) is blocked by google-adk, which pins opentelemetry-api<=1.44.
# The flaw is in parsing an inbound W3C tracestate HTTP header; this app does no inbound tracing.
PYSEC-2026-2598  # litellm
PYSEC-2026-2599  # litellm
PYSEC-2026-2600  # litellm
PYSEC-2026-2601  # litellm
PYSEC-2026-2602  # litellm
PYSEC-2026-3476  # litellm
PYSEC-2026-3477  # litellm
PYSEC-2026-3479  # litellm
PYSEC-2026-3861  # litellm
PYSEC-2026-388  # litellm
PYSEC-2026-391  # litellm
PYSEC-2026-4066  # litellm
PYSEC-2026-4067  # litellm
PYSEC-2026-4070  # litellm
CVE-2026-114603  # opentelemetry-api
